description: Source file defining the 'HTTP_WebDAV_Server' class, which implements a base class for a WebDAV server, handling HTTP methods such as OPTIONS, PROPFIND, PROPPATCH, MKCOL, GET, PUT, DELETE, LOCK, UNLOCK, COPY, and MOVE. It includes methods for request dispatching, lock management, property handling, and HTTP response generation.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server
classes.description: A virtual base class for implementing WebDAV servers, providing methods to handle WebDAV-specific HTTP requests and requests dispatching.

methods.name: ServeRequest
methods.description: Dispatches incoming WebDAV HTTP requests to the appropriate handler method based on request method.

methods.name: http_OPTIONS
methods.description: Handles the OPTIONS HTTP method by indicating supported methods and WebDAV compliance level.

methods.name: http_PROPFIND
methods.description: Handles the PROPFIND method by retrieving properties of resources.

methods.name: http_PROPPATCH
methods.description: Handles the PROPPATCH method for modifying properties.

methods.name: http_MKCOL
methods.description: Handles the MKCOL method for creating collections.

methods.name: http_GET
methods.description: Handles the GET method for retrieving resources.

methods.name: http_HEAD
methods.description: Handles the HEAD method to obtain resource headers.

methods.name: http_PUT
methods.description: Handles the PUT method for uploading or updating resources.

methods.name: http_DELETE
methods.description: Handles the DELETE method for removing resources.

methods.name: http_COPY
methods.description: Handles the COPY method for copying resources.

methods.name: http_MOVE
methods.description: Handles the MOVE method for moving resources.

methods.name: http_LOCK
methods.description: Handles the LOCK method for locking resources.

methods.name: http_UNLOCK
methods.description: Handles the UNLOCK method for releasing locks.

methods.name: _copymove
methods.description: Helper to perform copy or move operations based on argument.

methods.name: _allow
methods.description: Returns an array of HTTP methods supported by this server instance.

methods.name: mkprop
methods.description: Helper to create a property array with namespace, name, and value.

methods.name: _check_auth
methods.description: Checks if authentication is required and if it succeeds, by calling user-implemented checkAuth or check_auth methods.

methods.name: _new_uuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID for lock tokens.

methods.name: _new_locktoken
methods.description: Creates a new lock token string.

methods.name: _if_header_lexer
methods.description: Lexical parser for the 'If' header at the token level.

methods.name: _if_header_parser
methods.description: Parses the full 'If' header into a structured array.

methods.name: _check_if_header_conditions
methods.description: Evaluates 'If' header conditions, dealing with resource locking state.

methods.name: _check_uri_condition
methods.description: Stub for URI condition checks; should be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: _check_lock_status
methods.description: Checks lock status of a resource using user-implemented checkLock method.

methods.name: lockdiscovery
methods.description: Generates an XML lockdiscovery report based on current lock status.

methods.name: http_status
methods.description: Sets HTTP response status and a custom header.

methods.name: _urlencode
methods.description: Minimalistic URL encoding for special characters.

methods.name: _urldecode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string.

methods.name: _prop_encode
methods.description: Encodes text as UTF-8 if not already encoded.
